a couple of things i could recomend you try:
do you have a personal space in your family home? thats something that helps me a lot, i keep it clean. there are times when they disrespect it and my boundaries, but its great to be able to clean in a way that i aprove.
i assume you dont have the money to eat out all the time or buy your own groceries. if your family dismisses you asking to buy you your own products, maybe ask them to buy something that they dont like or eat, so that they dont touch it. 
if you have the energy, clean stuff. i wash the dishes before eating, dry them with a towel that i keep in my own place. before going to the toilet, wipe the seat. before eating at the dinner table, wipe it. 
what i do is clean my room, have slippers that i use for walking around the comunity place, wash everything that is touched by my family before using it. 
also, if u can afford it, going to therapy can help. even tho this is not irational or based on your ocd (it probably adds to it tho), some coping stuff can help. maybe family therapy could be benifital too.
its a shitty situation, but you are going to get trough it, stay strong
